changelog:
Initial release of controlnet-pose skill for RunComfy:

- Enables pose-conditioned image and video generation via the RunComfy CLI.
- Automatically routes to the appropriate model—Kling Motion Control (video pose transfer), Wan 2-2 Animate (audio/video-driven animation), or Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA (image pose conditioning).
- Supports reference types: pose/skeleton, motion, depth map, canny edge, and more.
- Matches intended generation mode (video vs image, stylized vs photoreal) based on request context.
- Includes trigger phrases for intuitive activation (e.g., "controlnet", "pose control", "transfer pose", "openpose", "depth control", "use this pose").
- Provides links and command examples for easy onboarding and advanced usage.
display_name: ControlNet & Pose — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Pose-conditioned generation on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro / Standard (transfer the motion / blocking of a reference video onto a target character), community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation with pose conditioning), and Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA (pose-conditioned image generation from an OpenPose / DWPose / canny / depth control image). Picks the right route based on video vs still and stylized vs photoreal. Triggers on "controlnet", "control net", "pose control", "openpose", "DWPose", "transfer pose", "motion control", "pose driven", "character pose", "depth control", "canny edge", "use this pose", or any explicit ask to condition generation on a pose / skeleton / motion / depth / canny reference.
